description: An editor-neutral timeline manifest: media references + timing only. It is NOT a renderer and contains no rendered media. HIERARCHY (stable identifiers + explicit relationships): Project -> Timeline -> Scene -> Shot -> (Character / Dialogue Line / Voice Profile / Audio Asset) and Video Clip; Audio Track -> Audio Clip. VoiceStudio receives the stable dialogue/audio IDs (dialogue_line_id, audio_asset_id, voice_profile_id) and OpenMontage receives the stable shot/video IDs (shot_id, scene_id, media_asset_id, clip_id) from this ONE shared timeline — never two independent timelines. v2.5 ADDITIVE MIGRATION (CF-WO-P0-007 Correction A): new fields are optional; no existing required field was removed or retyped, so every valid v2.3 record remains valid. Cross-reference rules that the restricted JSON-Schema subset cannot express (a Shot ID must exist in its shot plan; a Voice Profile must belong to the clip's Character; a Dialogue Line must exist in its performance plan) are enforced semantically by validate_timeline_cross_references() in tests/test_timeline_manifest.py.

aspect_ratio.description: Timeline aspect ratio (v2.5). 'other' covers ratios outside this list; the exact ratio is then recorded in notes.

frame_rate.description: Timeline frame rate in frames per second, e.g. 24, 25, 30 (v2.5). Governs conversion when timebase is 'frames' or 'timecode'; in_seconds/out_seconds always stay in seconds.

hierarchy.description: Explicit hierarchy map (v2.5): Project -> Timeline -> Scene -> Shot -> (Character / Dialogue Line / Voice Profile / Audio Asset) and Video Clip, plus Audio Track -> Audio Clip. Mirrors the clip-level bindings in one place so a reader (or a handoff to VoiceStudio/OpenMontage) sees the whole relationship tree without walking every track. All IDs here are the same stable IDs used on the clips.

timeline_id.description: The timeline this hierarchy describes; normally the manifest's own id.

performance_plan_id.description: Performance Plan this timeline is built from (v2.5). Stable link to schemas/performance-plan.json.

scene_plan_id.description: Scene Plan this timeline is built from (v2.5). Stable link to schemas/scene-plan.json.

script_to_performance_id.description: Script-to-Performance record binding the plans above (v2.5). Stable link to schemas/script-to-performance.json.

sequence_id.description: Stable identity of this timeline sequence within the project (v2.5). Distinct from the manifest record id: one project may hold several sequences.

shot_plan_id.description: Shot Plan this timeline is built from (v2.5). Stable link to schemas/shot-plan.json.

synchronization_groups.description: Synchronization groups (v2.5): each group associates several audio and video events WITHOUT renumbering their original clip IDs. A group lists the video clip IDs and audio clip IDs that play in sync, plus the dialogue lines and shots they realise.

timebase.description: Timestamp convention for this timeline (v2.5). 'seconds' is the default: all timing fields are seconds. 'frames' and 'timecode' are editor/OTIO-style conventions; they still require frame_rate so seconds can be derived. The validator subset cannot make frame_rate conditionally required, so frame_rate stays optional with this description.

audio_asset_id.description: Stable audio-asset ID for this clip's rendered audio (v2.5). Must resolve to the corresponding private/approved audio asset record — enforced by validate_timeline_cross_references().

audio_type.description: What kind of audio this clip carries (v2.5). dialogue/narration carry speech; music, ambience, sound-effect and foley carry no dialogue and need NO Character ID or Voice Profile ID; an intentional narration track needs no character voice binding.

character_id.description: Single speaking character for an audio clip (v2.5). A spoken line has one speaker; use character_ids on video clips for multi-character shots. Must resolve to a registered or approved-temporary character record.

character_ids.description: Characters visible/audible in this clip (v2.5). An array so a multi-character shot associates MORE than one Character ID. Each ID must resolve to a registered or approved-temporary character record.

dialogue_line_id.description: Dialogue line this clip carries or pictures (v2.5). Must exist in the referenced Performance Plan; a video clip's dialogue line must belong to one of the clip's characters. A music/ambience/SFX clip must NOT bind a dialogue line.

duration_seconds.description: Clip duration in seconds (v2.5). Strictly positive; a zero-length clip is invalid.

edit_note.description: Editing note for this clip, e.g. why a cut lands here (v2.5).

language.description: Spoken language of this audio clip, BCP-47 short form, e.g. 'bn', 'en', 'hi', 'en-US' (v2.5). Same pattern as voice-profile language.

media_asset_id.description: Stable media-asset ID for the clip's source media (v2.5). The media store resolves it; the timeline never embeds the media itself.

role.description: Speaking/listening role of this clip's character in the scene (v2.5). 'narrator' is for narration tracks with no visible character.

scene_id.description: Scene this clip belongs to (v2.5). Must exist in the referenced Scene Plan when a scene registry is supplied.

shot_id.description: Shot this clip belongs to (v2.5). Must exist in the referenced Shot Plan — enforced by validate_timeline_cross_references(), not by this schema.

shot_ids.description: Visual shots this audio clip is associated with (v2.5). An array so one audio asset/line may span several shots without renumbering any ID. Each ID must exist in the referenced Shot Plan.

source_media.description: Source-media kind for this clip (v2.5). Same vocabulary as the scene/shot-plan subject source_media.

timeline_end_seconds.description: Where the clip ends on the timeline, in seconds (v2.5). Must not be before timeline_start_seconds.

timeline_start_seconds.description: Where the clip starts on the timeline, in seconds (v2.5). Distinct from in_seconds, which is the start point inside the source media.

track_id.description: Track this clip belongs to (v2.5). Must match the enclosing track's track_id.

transition_in.description: Transition into this clip, e.g. 'cut', 'dissolve', 'fade-in', 'flash-frame' (v2.5). Free text so new transition styles need no schema change.

transition_out.description: Transition out of this clip to the next, e.g. 'cut', 'dissolve', 'fade-out', 'flash-frame' (v2.5).

voice_profile_id.description: Voice profile that speaks this clip (v2.5). Must resolve to a voice profile bound to this clip's character_id (or to the dialogue line's character) — an audio clip must never silently switch to another character's voice.

name.description: Human-readable track identity, e.g. 'V1 main', 'A1 dialogue' (v2.5). track_id stays the stable identifier.

title: TimelineManifest
